defs.def: an act of going into or getting into a place 进入（指行动）
the right or opportunity to enter a place 进入（指权利、机会）

ex.s: My marks plummet; I do badly in my examinations; I am refused entry to university.
ex.t: 我的成绩一落千丈；我考试考得很差；我被大学拒之门外。

defs.def: the right or opportunity to take part in sth or become a member of a group 参与，加入（指权利、机会）
something that you do, write or make to take part in a competition, for example answering a set of questions 参赛作品；竞赛答题

ex.s: ■Mail your entry to us by October 31 this year.
ex.t: ■在今年10月31日前将你的参赛作品邮寄给我们。

ex.s: We have received over 500 entries and have been amazed by your imaginations!
ex.t: 我们收到了 500 多份参赛作品，你们的想象力令我们惊叹不已！

ex.s: Write about your festival experience 1 Read the diary entry and answer the questions.
ex.t: 写下你的节日经历 1 阅读这篇日记，并回答问题。

defs.def: the act of taking part in a competition, race, etc. 参赛
the total number of people who are taking part in a competition, race, etc. 参赛人数
an item, for example a piece of information, that is written or printed in a dictionary, an account book, a diary, etc. 项目；条目；词条；账目；记录

ex.s: What you did on the spacecraft: How you felt: What you enjoyed most/least: Now write your journal entry.
ex.t: 你在宇宙飞船上的行动： 你的感受： 你最喜欢/最不喜欢什么： 现在写下你的日志条目。

ex.s: I decided that I wanted to learn as many words as I could and started marking every entry I looked up with a pencil to measure my progress.
ex.t: 那时我决心要尽可能多地学单词，并开始用铅笔标记每一个查过的词条，以此来衡量自己的进步。

ex.s: Students record short entries after each partner meeting noting the language skills practised and the topics discussed.
ex.t: 学生在每次搭档见面后记录简短条目，注明练习的语言技能和讨论的话题。

ex.s: Here is an entry from a commonly used dictionary.
ex.t: 这是一本常用词典里的一个词条。

defs.def: the act of recording information in a computer, book, etc. 登记；登录；录入
a door, gate or passage where you enter a building; an entrance hall 大门；入口处；通道；门厅

ex.s: Stories are an entry point to understanding a different experience of the world.
ex.t: 故事是理解不同世界体验的入口。
